identity description: A slightly tilted picture postcard with a cream border and one curled-up corner, the picture shows a simple sunny scene of three tiny red-roofed cottages on a green hill under a blue sky with a yellow sun, a small red stamp in the top right corner with a scalloped edge, no writing.

A chunky souvenir fridge magnet shaped like a postage stamp, thick wavy sky-blue scalloped frame around a cream square, a big glossy red strawberry with a green leaf top in the center, a small dark round magnet disc peeking out from behind.

A souvenir keychain: a brass split key ring with a short brass chain, hanging a small lighthouse charm with red and cream horizontal stripes, a red domed top with a tiny window, and a small arched door at the bottom.
A cream canvas tote bag standing upright with two tan handles, printed on the front with a simple flat picture of a little red-roofed house, a yellow sun and a few green grass tufts, no lettering.

A snow globe: a clear glass dome with a pale blue tint and a single white highlight, inside a tiny red-roofed cottage with snow on the roof and a small green pine tree on a snowy mound, a few simple white snowflake dots floating, sitting on its own round turned-wood base that is part of the object.

A souvenir clock tower model: a round cream stone tower with a red conical tiled roof topped by a small ball finial, a large round clock face with tick marks and two hands (no numbers), two small arched blue windows, standing on its own small square wooden plinth that is part of the object.

A miniature wooden ferris wheel model: a round wooden wheel with spokes and a brass hub on an A-frame stand, six small round gondola cabins around the rim alternating red, yellow and sky blue, on its own oval wooden plinth that is part of the object.

A tiny diorama of a rainy little town on a round wooden disc with a grass top: three small cottages with round mushroom-like roofs in red, sky blue and yellow, a small fluffy grey-blue rain cloud hovering above them dropping a few blue teardrop raindrops.
